question_en: Who founded the Maratha Empire?
explanation_en: Shivaji founded the Maratha Empire.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: What was the capital of Shivaji?
explanation_en: Raigad was the capital of Shivaji.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Which warfare tactic was used by Shivaji?
explanation_en: Shivaji used guerrilla warfare effectively.
explanation_ta: சிவாஜி கொரில்லா போர் முறையை திறமையாக பயன்படுத்தினார்.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: The council of eight ministers under Shivaji was called:
question_ta: சிவாஜியின் எட்டு அமைச்சர்கள் கொண்ட அமைச்சரவை எவ்வாறு அழைக்கப்பட்டது?
explanation_en: The council was called Ashta Pradhan.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Who was the son of Shivaji?
explanation_en: Sambhaji was the son of Shivaji.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Which Maratha leader never lost a battle?
question_ta: எந்த மராத்திய தலைவர் எந்த போரிலும் தோல்வியடையவில்லை?
explanation_en: Baji Rao I never lost a battle.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Which battle weakened the Maratha power greatly?
question_ta: மராத்திய சக்தியை மிகவும் பலவீனப்படுத்திய போர் எது?
explanation_en: The Third Battle of Panipat weakened the Marathas.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: What was Chauth?
explanation_en: Chauth was one-fourth tax collected by Marathas.
explanation_ta: சௌத் என்பது மராத்தியர்கள் வசூலித்த நான்கில் ஒரு பங்கு வரியாகும்.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Who became the first powerful Peshwa?
explanation_en: Balaji Vishwanath became the first powerful Peshwa.
explanation_ta: பாலாஜி விஸ்வநாத் முதல் சக்திவாய்ந்த பேஷ்வாவாக இருந்தார்.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Which Maratha ruler was called Chhatrapati?
question_ta: சத்திரபதி என்று அழைக்கப்பட்ட மராத்திய மன்னர் யார்?
explanation_en: Shivaji was called Chhatrapati Shivaji.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Which fort was important for Shivaji?
explanation_en: Raigad was Shivaji’s major fort and capital.
explanation_ta: ராய்கட் சிவாஜியின் முக்கிய கோட்டையும் தலைநகரமும் ஆகும்.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Who executed Sambhaji?
explanation_en: Aurangzeb captured and executed Sambhaji.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Which city became the center of Peshwa administration?
question_ta: பேஷ்வா நிர்வாகத்தின் மையமாக இருந்த நகரம் எது?
explanation_en: Pune became the center of Peshwa administration.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Who among the following strengthened the Maratha navy?
explanation_en: Shivaji developed a strong navy.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: What was Sardeshmukhi?
explanation_en: Sardeshmukhi was an additional tax collected by Marathas.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: In which year was Shivaji crowned?
explanation_en: Shivaji was crowned in 1674.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Which Maratha leader expanded Maratha influence in North India?
explanation_en: Baji Rao I expanded Maratha influence in North India.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Which movement influenced Maratha society?
explanation_en: Bhakti movement greatly influenced Maratha society.
explanation_ta: பக்தி இயக்கம் மராத்திய சமுதாயத்தை பெரிதும் பாதித்தது.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Who among the following was known as Nana Saheb?
explanation_en: Balaji Baji Rao was known as Nana Saheb.
explanation_ta: பாலாஜி பாஜிராவ் நானா சாகேப் என அழைக்கப்பட்டார்.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Which battle took place in 1761?
explanation_en: The Third Battle of Panipat took place in 1761.
subject: HISTORY

question_en: Who wrote 'History of the Marathas'?
explanation_en: Grant Duff wrote History of the Marathas.
subject: HISTORY
